title: The alternating-sign recurrence conjecture for spanning trees of graph products
statement: Let $G$ be any graph, and write $G_n=G\times P_n$. Let $T_n$ denote the number of spanning trees of $G_n$, which satisfies a linear recurrence by the preceding result. **Alternating-sign recurrence conjecture.** The recurrence for $\{T_n\}$ has coefficients that alternate in sign. This conjecture predicts a sign pattern for the linear recurrences governing spanning-tree counts of graph products with paths; the source provides no evidence of resolution.
source_name: Paul Raff, “Spanning Trees in Grid Graphs”, arXiv:0809.2551 (2008).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/0809.2551
